units.source_text: 一个汉子站在木台上，一边敲打大鼓边儿，一边提高嗓子歌唱。

en.t: A man stood on a wooden platform, beating a large drum while raising his voice in song.

units.source_text: 五六个跳大正舞的舞娘并排站在舞台上，背向帐篷里的观众，肩上扛着一把花阳伞，遮住了上半身，等待着起舞。

en.t: Five or six dancers who performed the Taisho dance stood side by side on the stage, with their backs to the audience in the tent, holding a flowered parasol on their shoulders to hide their upper bodies as they waited to begin dancing.

units.source_text: 骑在马背上的阿光，已经走到马戏团帐篷右边，从外面可以看到这番情形。

en.t: Ah Guang, riding on horseback, had already reached the right side of the circus tent, and from outside one could see this scene.

units.source_text: 帐篷外面也挂了一块大幕布，约莫每隔十分钟开幕落幕一次，让人瞧瞧花枝招展的舞娘。

en.t: A large curtain was also hung outside the tent, opening and closing about every ten minutes to let people glimpse the brightly dressed dancers.

units.source_text: 快要开演的时候，信号铃一响，就把大幕落下来。

en.t: When the performance was about to begin, as soon as the signal bell rang, they lowered the great curtain.

units.source_text: 这显然是要告诉人们：想观赏这些姑娘的舞蹈，在入口处付款打票吧。

en.t: This was clearly meant to tell people: if you want to watch these girls dance, pay at the entrance and buy a ticket.
